The Council renewed sanctions under resolution 2293 (2016) until 1 July 2024 [SANCTIONS]. Measures in resolution 1807 (2008) continue for nongovernmental entities in the DRC [SANCTIONS]. Russia voted for renewal [RUSSIA], arguing sanctions should adjust when outdated or impeding state-building [RUSSIA]. The Council extended the Group of Experts mandate to 1 August 2024 [EXPERTS]. It requested a midterm report by 30 December 2023 and a final report by 15 June 2024 [EXPERTS]. The Group must send monthly updates to the Committee, excluding report-due months [EXPERTS]. Russia welcomed the December 2022 removal of the DRC notification requirement [RUSSIA] and reiterated opposition to illegitimate unilateral sanctions [RUSSIA].
